title: 多轮LLM系统的状态化护栏：对话风险累积框架
summary: 提出对话风险累积（CRA）概念，指无害对话回合逐步组合成有害行为的失败模式。构建会话层CRA框架，追踪语义漂移、敏感加权信息累积图和合规梯度三个轨迹信号。提供无监督凸融合和CRA-Net DA模型进行评分。发布CRA-Bench基准（含1200个8轮会话）和轨迹原生评估协议。
summary_en: Proposes Conversational Risk Accumulation (CRA), where benign dialogue turns compose into harm. Introduces a session-layer framework tracking semantic drift, sensitivity-weighted information accumulation, and compliance gradient. Provides unsupervised convex fusion and CRA-Net DA for scoring. Releases CRA-Bench benchmark (1,200 eight-turn sessions) and trajectory-native evaluation protocol.
